_note: Gather MCP tool specs (2026-10-20 extension pack). Same shape as core.mjs LEGACY_TOOLS entries (name/title/description/inputSchema). Resolver notes assume wg_sessions/wg_rsvps/wg_reminders/wg_practice_plans from 0021_sessions.sql + existing records.

tools.description: Live and upcoming sessions: talks, Q&A, sits, study circles, classes, mentoring. Filter by topic, teacher, tradition or session kind. Returns session cards with join info only inside the reminder window (no join_url scraping).
tools.name: list_sessions
tools.resolver: wg_sessions WHERE starts_at > now, filter by atlas_nodes gids; kinds map to session kinds 1:1
tools.title: Sessions

tools.description: The caller's upcoming sessions (rsvps going/maybe) plus their active practice plans with today's step. Powers the agent reminder loop (T-10 join card).
tools.name: my_schedule
tools.resolver: wg_rsvps JOIN wg_sessions (who = caller) + wg_practice_plans active rows; practice step resolved from collection units by day count
tools.title: My schedule

tools.description: Put a session on the caller's calendar: returns an ICS file (VEVENT with join URL + Wiser deep link) plus Google/Apple add links. Never writes to third-party calendars directly.
tools.name: add_to_calendar
tools.resolver: stateless ICS builder from wg_sessions row; join_url embedded only if session is live or within 60 min
tools.title: Add to calendar

tools.description: The join link for a session the caller RSVPed to, inside the reminder window. Outside the window it returns when the window opens, not the link.
tools.name: join_url
tools.resolver: wg_sessions.join_url iff rsvp exists AND now within [starts_at - 15min, ends_at]; else the window time
tools.title: Join link

tools.description: Everything needed to walk into a session ready: the Atlas text or concept, the scholar notes, and one 5-minute primer talk (MMR pick from the topic pool).
tools.name: prep_for
tools.resolver: session.atlas_nodes -> get_* records; primer = MMR top talk under 6 min from the session topic pool (bySpeaker quality rank); scholar notes = works[] of scholar people in atlas_nodes
tools.title: Prepare for a session
